skill_name: Explain the concept of biodiversity and its importance?
workflow: Biodiversity is the variety of life on Earth, encompassing all of the different species of plants, animals, fungi, and microorganisms. It is important because it protects our environment and ensures the resilience of ecosystems. It also helps to maintain ecological balance and essential services, such as pollination and nutrient cycling.
